sentences.text:
Mr. S.K. Nayak, Advocate
 -versus-
 State of Odisha ....

Asc
 Coram: Justice V. Narasingh
 Order
23.12.2025 Order No.
01. 1.
Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The Petitioner is seeking pre-arrest bail in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No.145 of 2025 pending on the file of learned A.D.J.-cum-POCSO, Bhadrak arising out of Bhandaripokhari P.S.
Case No.510 of 2025 for commission of offences punishable under Sections 376(3), 376(20(f), 506 of IPC and under Section 6 of POCSO Act.
3. Learned counsel for the State opposes such prayer.
4. Taking into account the statement of the victim recorded under Section 183 of BNSS, this Court is not inclined to entertain this ABLAPL.

However, in the event the Petitioners surrender before the learned Court in seisin in the aforesaid case and move an application for their release on bail, the same shall be considered on its own merit.
5. Accordingly, the ABLAPL stands disposed of.
Soumya Judge Srikanta Behera vs State Of Odisha ....
